source: Wella Color Expert workbook 2026 (Sylvie's copy, scanned)

lines.name: Koleston Perfect ME+
lines.summary: Permanent colour with up to 100% grey coverage. Ranges: Pure Naturals, Rich Naturals, Vibrant Reds, Deep Browns, Special Blondes, Special Mix.

mix.for: Pure Naturals, Rich Naturals, Vibrant Reds, Deep Browns

dev.use: 1 level of lift; grey/white coverage on same depth or darker (Special Blonde: 3 levels)
Same depth or darker on natural hair, deeper result, no grey coverage needed

lines.name: Color Xpress
lines.summary: Retouch greys in 10 minutes. 14 shades for express grey root touch-up. Stops processing after 10 minutes.

lines.name: Illumina Color
lines.summary: Permanent colour that lightens, darkens and enhances with a sheer, natural result. Up to 3 levels of lift; blends or covers up to 100% grey. Cooler undertones fight brassiness.

dev.use: 1 level of lift; grey coverage same depth or darker

lines.name: Color Touch
lines.summary: Demi-permanent, up to 28 washes. Color Touch up to 50% grey coverage; Color Touch Plus up to 70%. Special Mix adds intensity of tone. Mirrors the Koleston Perfect shades.

mix.eg: 1 part colour + 2 parts Color Touch Emulsion 1.9% or 4%
1 part colour + 2 parts Color Touch Emulsion 4%

dev.use: Same depth or darkening with a soft regrowth; toning blondes; soft grey blending
More vibrancy; coarse hair; intense grey blending; up to 70% grey coverage with soft regrowth; low lift

lines.apply: On pre-shampooed damp or clean dry hair.

lines.name: Color Fresh
lines.summary: Ready to use; ammonia and developer free, acid pH. Lasts up to 10 shampoos; up to 30% grey blend.

time.for: Color Fresh pH 6.5 and Silver pH 6.5
time.noheat: 5–20 min, by condition and intensity wanted

lines.apply: Shampoo and towel dry, apply through lengths and ends, comb through; emulsify with warm water and rinse.

lines.name: Perfecton by Color Fresh
lines.summary: Leave-in temporary tone; ammonia and developer free. Grey blending up to 15%.

time.noheat: No development time; do not rinse

lines.apply: Shampoo and towel dry, mix in applicator flask, apply evenly. Do not rinse or shampoo again.

lines.name: Shinefinity
lines.summary: Zero lift, zero damage colour glaze. After blonding/lightening, between colour appointments, natural correction (balance moderate unevenness or darken without pre-colouring), balancing lengths with Koleston Perfect ME+ or Illumina on the root.
lines.apply: Pre-shampooed towel-dried, or dry hair. Add water and emulsify, then shampoo; no post-colour treatment needed. Pre-shampooed hair gives a softer result and shorter development.

lines.name: Blondor Multi Blonde Powder
lines.summary: Dust-free blue powder, up to 7 levels of lift; anti-yellow molecules.

time.noheat: By lift needed and hair condition; do not exceed 50 min. Do not use heat.

lines.name: Blondor Soft Blonde Cream
lines.summary: Cream lightener recommended for on-scalp techniques, up to 7 levels of lift.

time.noheat: By lift needed and hair condition; do not exceed 50 min. Do not use heat.

lines.name: BlondorPlex 9 Powder
lines.summary: Lightening powder with bond builder technology, up to 9 levels of lift.

mix.eg: 30g powder + 45ml Welloxon Perfect 4%, 6%, 9% or 12% (6% on scalp only)

dev.use: By lift needed; 6% only on scalp

time.noheat: By lift needed and hair condition; do not exceed 50 min. Do not use heat.

lines.name: Blondor Freelights
lines.summary: White lightening powder for freehand and highlight techniques, up to 7 levels of lift. Use only with Freelights developers.

time.noheat: Up to 50 min, by lift needed

lines.name: Magma by Blondor
lines.summary: Lifts and tones in one step on coloured or virgin hair, for foils and freehand. Off-scalp only, on dry hair.

lines.name: BlondorPlex Cream Toners
lines.summary: Express toning after any bleaching service; neutralises unwanted warmth and brassiness.

time.noheat: 5 min. Longer gives more neutralisation and a deeper, more saturated result.

lines.apply: After lightening, shampoo and post-service treatment, then tone.

corrective.name: Mild lightener
corrective.when: Removing old colour, bands or a build-up of pigment, and preparing hair for a new colour. Controlled lift of up to 2–3 levels.
corrective.mix: 1:4 — 1 part Blondor (Multi Blonde Powder 7, Soft Blonde Cream 7 or BlondorPlex 9) + 4 parts Welloxon Perfect Pastel 1.9%
corrective.apply: Bowl and brush on dry hair, darkest areas first (or on pre-shampooed hair for softer results). Check porosity first.
corrective.time: Up to 30 min, or until the undertone you want is reached
corrective.remove: Rinse, shampoo and anti-oxy (neutralise). Dry, then apply the chosen colour; demi and semi-permanent can go on damp hair.

corrective.name: Blondor lightening
corrective.when: Greater lightening, if the hair's condition allows. Assess texture and porosity first.
corrective.mix: 1:1.5 to 1:2 — 1 part Blondor + 1.5 or 2 parts Welloxon Perfect 4% to 12%
corrective.apply: Bowl and brush on dry hair, darkest areas first; work gently into the hair.

corrective.name: Color Renew
corrective.when: Gentle alternative to persulfate products: reduces unwanted oxidative colour without lightening the natural colour. Allows more frequent colour changes.
corrective.mix: 1:10 — one 9g sachet Color Renew Crystal Powder (A) + 90ml Activator Liquid (B)
corrective.apply: Bowl or applicator bottle; roots to mid-lengths and ends.
corrective.time: 5–45 min, depending on how much colour you want to reduce
corrective.remove: Rinse with water only, then go on with the target colour. If cleaning out highlights: rinse, shampoo and condition.

corrective.name: Pre-pigmentation with Perfecton
corrective.when: Darkening bleached hair to depth 8 and darker. Follow with Koleston Perfect or Illumina Color. Shades shown: /3, /43, /44.
corrective.apply: Bottle or sponge on dry hair; comb through evenly.
corrective.remove: Pat dry with a tissue or towel (p.65: towel dry or cool hairdryer), then apply the chosen formula.

corrective.name: Pre-pigmentation with Koleston Perfect Special Mix 0/43
corrective.when: Rich, vibrant target shades (reds and coppers). 0/43 has the high amount of direct dye needed for pre-pigmentation. Follow with vibrant or warm Koleston Perfect shades.
corrective.apply: Bowl and brush or sponge on dry, lightened hair only; comb through evenly.
corrective.time: Up to 15 min, no heat (poster: 10–15 min)
corrective.remove: Rinse and dry, then apply the Koleston Perfect target shade.
corrective.conflict: The pages disagree on depth: p.29 and the poster say depth 8/0 or darker; p.65 says 6/0 or darker. The method list on p.65 also says levels 6 and below.

corrective.name: Color Touch filling (2 steps)
corrective.when: Going darker without the commitment of permanent colour; ideal for poor condition, high porosity hair.
corrective.mix: Step 1 (filler): 1 part Color Touch + 2 parts Color Touch Emulsion 1.9% (e.g. 30g + 60g), using the chart below. Step 2: your target shade.
corrective.apply: Bowl and brush or bottle on pre-shampooed, towel-dried hair; comb through evenly.
corrective.remove: Rinse until the water runs clear, towel dry, then apply the target Color Touch shade.
corrective.tip: Filling formulas are a guide: adjust for hair condition and porosity. Too warm an undertone when pre-pigmenting keeps exposing too much red (p.66).
corrective.conflict: The poster (PDF p.177) gives the same mixes in grams but from depth 6 down puts them one depth lower: 6 = 15g 9/03 + 5g 8/73 or 30g 7/7; 5 = 5g 6/4 + 10g 6/7 + 5g 9/03; 4 = 20g 6/4 + 10g 6/7; 3 = 15g 6/4 + 5g 6/7; 2 = none. Check which your educator uses.

corrective.name: Koleston Perfect back to natural (1 step)
corrective.when: Long-lasting, natural-looking result when darkening pre-lightened or highlighted hair, in one step.
corrective.mix: 1 part formula + 2 parts Welloxon Perfect 4% (e.g. 30g + 60g), using the chart below
corrective.apply: Bowl and brush on dry hair; saturate the pre-lightened hair and avoid the natural regrowth to prevent lift. Comb through with a wide-tooth comb every 10 min.
corrective.remove: Rinse thoroughly, shampoo lightly and finish with INVIGO Post Color Treatment.
corrective.tip: To enhance or adjust tone afterwards, overlay a gloss: target shade 1:1:1 with Welloxon Perfect Pastel 1.9% and INVIGO Post Color Treatment, up to 15 min (p.67).
corrective.conflict: For 3/0 the poster (PDF p.165) gives 10g 2/0 + 20g 4/77 (1:2), where p.31 gives 1:1.
